title: I Built an Entire Marketing Team With 0 Employees #shorts #claude #automatedsystem #aiagent #ai
description:
In this video, we break down the secret to building a one-person company that feels like you have 23 employees working for you.

Thirty-six AI agents run your entire marketing: the research, the content, the posting, the email, and the numbers. Because marketing is not a funnel. It is a loop. Research finds the angle, content writes it, creative designs it, distribution ships it, audience keeps them coming back, and analytics reads what worked. And what worked decides next week's content.

Here is what we cover:

Research and Content. A topic starts spiking and the brain already knows. Google Trends, Semrush, and SparkToro feed the same brain. It reads what is trending and what your audience actually cares about, off a file you wrote once. Claude writes the post, Surfer makes it rank, and then it stops, because the final yes is still yours.

Creative and Distribution. Canva and Midjourney build the graphic, Remotion renders the short in code, ElevenLabs does the voice, no editor. Metricool schedules it across every channel at the hour each one lands. A comment or DM comes in and ManyChat replies in your voice before you have opened the app.

Analytics. It is not a report anymore. It is what happens after every post. Looker Studio reads what converted, checks what you made against what actually worked, and feeds it straight back into research. Next week it makes more of that.

The layer that ties it together: Claude Code, over MCP, into your CRM, your calendar, and your channels. Underneath it, plain files: your voice, your offer, your rules. AI moves the information. You move the brand and the budget.

If you are a solo founder or a small team, this is the systems architecture that lets one person run the output of a full marketing department.

Built by Structure Webworks. We design agentic AI systems for founders and small teams.
